title: rag.py pack --item refuses every root but _self, so a brief for a project's own kb root needs the item's title and goal as a question
goal: rag.py pack --root ROOT --item ID serves a kb root other than _self: the question is the item's title and goal, as for _self, so backlog.py brief calls one command for every root.

run: import subprocess, sys; p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', '--root', 'public', '--item', 'BG-aaaaaaaa'], capture_output=True, text=True); sys.exit(1 if 'needs --root' in p.stderr else 0)
